_ruling.words: let's add a little Christmassy stuff to every platform, right? And we do that seasonally, and we do that for holidays, for general holidays.

_how_it_works: Every public page of gputnammusic.com and 2kleigh.com reads this file (components/SeasonalTouch.tsx).
Only an entry with status "live" AND a look turns anything on. A "draft" entry shows nothing, anywhere.
Dates are month-day, inclusive at both ends, read in time_zone. A window may wrap the new year (start after end).
A look adds and never replaces: it keeps each site's own colors, never covers text, buttons or the music player, never flashes, and holds still for anyone who asks their device for reduced motion.
Each draft look is built and shown to GD before its date. Its status moves to "live" only on his yes.

holidays.name: Christmas
holidays.notes: A string of lights draped across both top corners and a small tree in each top corner (evergreen, light amber and warm white bulbs; no red, no pink, per GD 2026-11-28), soft falling snow behind the page's content, thin evergreen edges on cards. Turns itself off after Dec 26 (America/Chicago). The PR holding it is a draft until GD has seen the pictures.
